figurative_meaning_en: By good fortune, by the favor of fate, suddenly
example_sentences_in_bangla: কপাল ক্রমে সে লটারিতে জিতে গেল।
হঠাৎ কপাল জোরে তার চাকরির সুযোগ এল।
example_sentences_in_english: By good fortune, he won the lottery.
Suddenly, by the force of fate, the job opportunity came his way.
note: Variations reflect nuances in expressing inevitable or fortunate outcomes in Bengali folklore.
